ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution located primarily at the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottled patches are concentrated at the distal lateral tips of both lobes. Multiple isolated, small white circular pixel clusters (scars) are distributed across the central black field, particularly in the upper half of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a visible vertex and an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 48 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration with varying peak amplitudes (5-20 pixels) along the continuous boundary of both lobes, including a deeper notch-like irregularity on the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature from the tips transitioning to a deep concave sweep toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosette scars) are visible: at least four on the right lobe and three on the left lobe, ranging from 10-25 pixels in diameter.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological colonization (dense barnacle clusters) is present on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, appearing as brown/tan high-texture geometric masses protruding from the fluke's natural boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific deep-V indentation is visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately 60% of the distance from the central notch to the tip.
